MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 2
   C. 14
   D. 49

2. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 7
   C. 14
   D. 49

3. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 4

4. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 21
   C. 17
   D. 15

5. Solve for x: x + 8 = 16. (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 8
   C. 9
   D. 8

6. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 144
   C. 48
   D. 156

7. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 22
   C. 122
   D. 121

8. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 13
   C. 37
   D. 5

9. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x = 5
   B. x < 5
   C. x ≥ 0 only
   D. x > 5

10. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 90
   C. 81
   D. 36

11. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 20
   C. 1
   D. 21

12. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 4
   D. 400

13. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 65
   C. 0
   D. 64

14. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 12
   C. 33
   D. 4

15. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 3, 6, 9
   B. 1, 2, 3, 6
   C. 2, 4, 6
   D. 1, 6

16. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 18
   C. 82
   D. 81

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
